claims.statement: Gian Giacomo Caprotti, called Salai, aged ten, joins the household. Leonardo's note records the cost of his clothes and a list of his thefts.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Leonardo's own notebook entry.
